failure: An ordinary discussion acquired a mandatory planning workflow.
requiredBehavior: Use Blueprint only on explicit request; check_content works without a plan.
labelAuthority: agent-curated interpretation of owner feedback; raw messages remain private

failure: A document repeated aspirations without operation contracts.
requiredBehavior: The Goal states the outcome. Each solution flow explains inputs, ownership, operations, results and adjacent interfaces.
labelAuthority: agent-curated interpretation of owner feedback; raw messages remain private

failure: Approval of one paragraph was treated as approval of the entire plan.
requiredBehavior: Record actual approval scope and exact displayed revision; do not infer blanket approval.
labelAuthority: agent-curated interpretation of owner feedback; raw messages remain private

failure: Mechanical test, caller and bookkeeping repairs asked for another approval.
requiredBehavior: Complete routine repairs inside approved behavior; ask only for a material contract or scope decision.
labelAuthority: agent-curated interpretation of owner feedback; raw messages remain private

failure: The review required a pushed PR with passing CI.
requiredBehavior: Complete local gate, requested review, affected fixes, then implementation publication and CI.
labelAuthority: agent-curated interpretation of owner feedback; raw messages remain private

failure: Intermediate work commits triggered repeated CI.
requiredBehavior: Keep intermediate work local; reconcile repeated publication and avoid duplicate pushes.
labelAuthority: agent-curated interpretation of owner feedback; raw messages remain private

failure: A feature was merged without the owner's separate instruction.
requiredBehavior: Publishing and green CI do not authorize protected-branch merge.
labelAuthority: agent-curated interpretation of owner feedback; raw messages remain private

failure: Questions contained unexplained Stage IDs, line numbers and dumps.
requiredBehavior: Show the user-facing behavior, the relevant quotation and a concrete consequence; keep technical IDs in structured records.
labelAuthority: agent-curated interpretation of owner feedback; raw messages remain private

failure: A semantic opinion became an execution barrier.
requiredBehavior: Return evidence and uncertainty; advice does not create permission or a passed requirement.
labelAuthority: agent-curated interpretation of owner feedback; raw messages remain private

failure: Word counts and required table layouts generated work without improving the solution.
requiredBehavior: Check factual contracts and readable behavior; no arbitrary literary form requirements.
labelAuthority: agent-curated interpretation of owner feedback; raw messages remain private

failure: Every local commit reran a complete suite.
requiredBehavior: Run affected checks during work and the complete local gate at publication; reuse unchanged evidence.
labelAuthority: agent-curated interpretation of owner feedback; raw messages remain private

failure: Process changes affected unrelated active agents.
requiredBehavior: Trial in a selected checkout and separate MCP session; do not reinstall all agents.
labelAuthority: agent-curated interpretation of owner feedback; raw messages remain private

failure: Reducing type count removed a necessary input/output boundary.
requiredBehavior: Reward sufficient reuse, not the smallest number of names or lines.
labelAuthority: agent-curated interpretation of owner feedback; raw messages remain private

failure: Only recent or poorly organized examples were used as a quality reference.
requiredBehavior: Inventory historical sources; separate Goal, flow and interface cases; keep variants of a source in one split.
labelAuthority: agent-curated interpretation of owner feedback; raw messages remain private
